Growing the future
About Us
Legacy Coop Access | Customer Portal
Helping you grow. That’s what we’re here for. To serve the farms, ranches, businesses and people of western Nebraska and eastern Wyoming.
Legacy Coop is here to ensure that you can get what you need to keep your operation running. What started out as small farmer-founded coops, has grown to help meet the requirements of today’s producers and businesses all across our service area. With everything from seed, feed, and fuel to grain storage and marketing, Legacy Coop is here to serve you. At Legacy Coop, we pride ourselves on providing top-quality products and services at competitive prices.
Our story
Company Updates:
Your Complete Agricultural Partner in Nebraska and Wyoming
For decades, Legacy COOP has been the backbone of agricultural communities across Nebraska and Wyoming. We understand the unique challenges farmers face in our region, from unpredictable weather patterns to evolving market demands. That’s why we’ve built our services around one simple principle: your success is our success.
Whether you’re managing thousands of acres or running a family operation, our experienced team provides the expertise, resources, and personalized support you need to maximize your yield and profitability. We’re not just another supplier—we’re your neighbors, committed to growing alongside you.
Comprehensive Services for Every Farming Need
Agronomy
Our certified agronomists bring decades of experience in Wyoming and Nebraska soil conditions. We provide customized crop nutrition programs, precision agriculture solutions, and field consulting services that optimize your yields while protecting your investment. From soil testing to harvest planning, we’re with you every step of the growing season.
Learn More
Grain
Maximize your grain marketing opportunities with our competitive pricing, flexible contracts, and strategic storage solutions. Our grain division understands local market conditions and helps you time your sales for optimal returns.
Learn More
Member/Credit Forms
Become a member of our cooperative family or secure credit for your agricultural needs.
Learn More
Energy
Keep your equipment running with reliable fuel delivery and competitive pricing on diesel, gasoline, and propane. Our energy division ensures you have the power you need when you need it most.
Learn More
Feed
Quality livestock nutrition starts with quality feed. Our feed specialists help you optimize animal performance with customized nutrition programs and premium feed products tailored to your livestock operation.
Learn More
Retail
From crop protection products to farm supplies, our retail division stocks everything you need to keep your operation running smoothly. Count on us for quality products and expert advice.
Learn More
Why Farmers Choose Legacy COOP
Local expertise
Our team lives and works in the communities we serve. We understand Nebraska and Wyoming farming conditions, regulations, and market opportunities better than anyone.
Personalized service
Every farm is different. That’s why we take the time to understand your operation and provide customized solutions that fit your specific needs and goals.
Comprehensive solutions
From agronomy services to farm loans , we’re your one-stop partner for all your agricultural needs. Streamline your operations by working with a single, trusted provider.
Proven results
Generations of farmers have trusted Legacy COOP to help them succeed. Our track record speaks for itself—we help farms grow, prosper, and pass on to the next generation.
